prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing page direction comp for TomorrowWorks
Render a complete 1440×900 public Malaysian career guidance website viewport, edge to edge, with crisp readable text and a small start of the next section. The visitor wants to enter their current role and see where it can lead.
Content: brand “TomorrowWorks”; navigation “Explore careers”, “Job market”, “How it works”, “For organisations”; utility “BM / 中文”. Main statement: “Your experience can take you further.” Working sentence-form control: “I work as [Accounting assistant]” followed by the action “Show me where it can lead”. Under it, one quiet line: “Malaysian job-market evidence · No CV required”. The next section begins with “One role. More than one possible future.”
Direction: One Clear Step. Treat the whole first viewport as one editorial sequence rather than a collection of UI blocks. A fine route rule begins at the role field and continues toward the lower edge, with one small verified marker only. Everything else is open space. Navigation and language control sit neatly at the top with “For organisations” on the right side.
Use a near-white ground, deep blue-black text, a restrained green action, and a barely warm grey rule. Typography is modern, finely spaced and premium, with clear hierarchy but no oversized marketing spectacle.
Do not show destination cards, career suggestions, dashboards, feature rows, statistics, photography, illustrations, gradients, floating glass surfaces, AI imagery, decorative icons or fake logos. No browser frame or watermark.
